CLI core complete. 65 tests pass, golangci-lint clean. Verified live: core<user<project precedence with shadowed provenance; same-scope ambiguity is a hard error (exit 1); pure-JSON stdout with human diagnostics on stderr; nested SKILL.md rejected; symlink escape rejected; host-collision warning fires against the real .agents/skills/beads and stays non-fatal. DEVIATION: fixture packs are built in t.TempDir rather than committed under testdata, so no stray SKILL.md files exist for the host's recursive scanner to discover. Init creates the pack and gitignore entry; opencode.json skills.paths registration is deferred to M4 as planned.

Model registry and managed integrity complete on branch feat/sv-i1j.3-model-registry-integrity (8e8743e). 96 tests, lint clean. Verified live against a real installation: three external spellings (anthropic/claude-opus-5, openrouter/anthropic/claude-opus-5, openrouter/~anthropic/claude-opus-latest) collapse to one canonical identity; near-misses like anthropic/claude-opus correctly do not match; modified managed file warns and continues at exit 0; hand-added core skill directory is not discovered; missing managed file is fatal at exit 1 even for 'version'. Found and fixed a real defect: make generate-check used git diff, which is blind to untracked files and silently passed on stale generated output.

Transactional sync, status, locking and fingerprinting complete on feat/sv-i1j.4-sync-status (db41b55, pushed). 160 tests, lint clean, cross-builds linux/darwin/windows.

SPIKE RESOLVED: skills.paths arrays REPLACE across config scopes, they do not concatenate; verified with a control run. init therefore merges into any existing array rather than overwriting, and a shadowed global skills.paths now warns.

Verified live on this repo: sync publishes to .structured-vibe/generated/opencode/skills and 'opencode debug skill' confirms the host loads all six sv-* skills from the snapshot, resolving the M1 bootstrap caveat. Failed sync (integration removed) left the previous snapshot and state intact. Concurrent sync failed immediately with sync.locked, verified from a separate process holding a real flock. Status transitions missing -> current -> stale -> current were exercised by adding and removing a project-scope skill.

DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED: sync creates .structured-vibe/ for generated output, and env.Load treated the existence of that directory as a project pack, so running sync before init left every subsequent command failing on a missing manifest. Only a manifest now declares a pack; regression test added.

SCOPE ADDITION: host-collision detection extended to other configured skills.paths entries, scanned recursively to match host behavior. This caught six real collisions on this repo during verification.

CARRIED TO M5: a placeholder no-op plugin is installed at ~/.config/opencode/plugins/svibe.js so sync's integration precondition could be exercised. M5 must replace it via 'svibe admin setup opencode'.

OpenCode integration complete on feat/sv-i1j.5-opencode-plugin (175c371, pushed). 175 tests, lint clean, TS typechecks, cross-builds.

Verified live against OpenCode 1.18.18, not by reasoning alone: opus-5 + sv-plan (requires A) silent; haiku-4-5 + sv-plan warns with correct tiers A vs C; haiku + sv-execute (requires C) silent; a skill loaded twice produces one advise subprocess (dedup); cwd guard fires from a subdirectory exactly when the host logs 'skill path not found' and is silent from the repo root; admin setup/update install byte-identical artifacts and update skips uninstalled hosts.

TWO DEFECTS FOUND BY LIVE TESTING:
1. Plugin read model.modelID which does not exist on the host Model type; the field is model.id. Every model would have resolved undefined and warned constantly. Caught by TypeScript against the real @opencode-ai/plugin types, which is the concrete justification for the TS build step.
2. The 'title' agent fires chat.params with small_model inside the user's own session. Tracking 'last model seen' attributed skill loads to the title model. Observed: agent=title model=claude-haiku-4-5 then agent=build model=claude-opus-5 under one sessionID. An A-tier skill on opus would have produced a false tier C warning. Fixed by keying model per session and ignoring internal agents (title, summary, compaction).

The M4 placeholder plugin has been replaced by the real built artifact via 'svibe admin setup opencode'.

ENVIRONMENT NOTE for M6: a real managed payload is now installed at ~/.config/svibe and the binary at ~/.local/bin/svibe, so the plugin can invoke svibe from PATH. The M6 installer should produce this same layout.

Release pipeline, installer and README complete on feat/sv-i1j.6-release-installer (6067039, pushed).

Packaging lives in the Makefile (make dist, make dist-verify) so it is verifiable locally rather than only inside CI. Archive layout matches architecture 17.1: svibe, core/, config/models.yaml, integrations/opencode/svibe.js. Six platform archives plus checksums.txt.

Verified locally: packaged binary reports the injected version and passes its own managed-integrity check against the payload shipped beside it; a clean install from artifact resolves all six core skills.

Installer verified against a local release server: tampered archive aborts with a checksum mismatch and installs nothing; upgrade replaces a locally modified managed file while a user pack survives and still resolves; config root mirrors Go os.UserConfigDir including the macOS Application Support path, which the CLI must agree with or it would not find the payload.

GAP FOUND AND CLOSED: the packaged smoke test originally trusted the exit code, but a modified managed file only warns (exit 0). Manifest/payload drift is exactly the bug packaging introduces, so it would have shipped silently. The step now fails on any managed diagnostic, confirmed to catch simulated drift.

NOT YET EXERCISED: the release workflow has never run, since that requires publishing a real GitHub release. Its rollback path in particular is unproven against the live API. The first real release is the test.

Field removed from code, core skills and architecture. Independently verified PASS by openai/gpt-5.4 in fresh context. Executed correctly on the first attempt by anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5, a tier C model, against a tier C bead.

Full chain exercised on real work (sv-i1j.8). Four roles across three models: plan and finalize on claude-opus-5, review and verify on gpt-5.4, execute on claude-haiku-4-5. A tier C model executed a tier C bead correctly on the first attempt with no escalation and no human correction.
